company.name: Embedder
company.shortDescription: Hardware-Aware AI for Embedded Software Development
company.description: Embedder is an AI agent for embedded software. It reads your datasheets and schematics, writes the code, flashes the board, runs the tests, and fixes its own mistakes. Testing is hardware-in-the-loop: Embedder drives the equipment your team already owns (debug probes, logic analyzers, power profilers, oscilloscopes) and validates firmware on real silicon, not just against a compiler. Embedder works with some of the top semiconductor ecosystems in the world, supporting 500+ MCUs and 3,000+ peripherals.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered firmware development platform that uses datasheets, schematics, source code, and hardware-in-the-loop testing to generate, flash, validate, debug, and revise embedded software.
productsAndServices.name: Embedder AI Agent for Embedded Firmware

productsAndServices.description: A hardware-in-the-loop testing service that generates and executes firmware tests on real boards, integrates with bench equipment, and can diagnose and re-validate fixes automatically.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Testing

productsAndServices.description: A firmware debugging service that combines source analysis with live debugger state, serial output, bus captures, and electrical measurements to identify hardware-related failures.
productsAndServices.name: Debugging & Root-Cause Analysis

productsAndServices.description: A hardware-validated optimization service that measures firmware timing, memory, and power consumption, applies part-specific changes, and verifies the results through repeated tests on real hardware.
productsAndServices.name: Performance Optimization

productsAndServices.description: A firmware migration service for moving embedded projects between MCUs, RTOSes, programming models, or implementation languages while checking target-specific hardware behavior.
productsAndServices.name: Platform Migrations

productsAndServices.description: An AI-assisted board bring-up and firmware development service that uses hardware documentation and schematics to generate initial drivers and validate them on a connected development board.
productsAndServices.name: Rapid Prototyping
